expected.ret: How the working sets went (counting total reps across all sets).
How the working sets went (at least 2 sets must fully hit, capped at the sets the session issues; every logged set counts).

- if your stage is “5x3”:
  - if the working sets totalled their target reps (and every other bound was met): Set working weight to your working weight plus {inc}.
  - if the total reps fell short with every set logged, or a set missed another bound: Set stage to “6x2”.
  - if nothing decided it: Something went unlogged: leave everything as is.
- if your stage is “6x2”:
  - if the working sets totalled their target reps (and every other bound was met): Set working weight to your working weight plus {inc}.
  - if the total reps fell short with every set logged, or a set missed another bound: Set stage to “10x1”.
  - if nothing decided it: Something went unlogged: leave everything as is.
- if your stage is “10x1”:
  - if the working sets totalled their target reps (and every other bound was met): Set working weight to your working weight plus {inc}.
  - if the total reps fell short with every set logged, or a set missed another bound: Set stage to “retest”.
  - if nothing decided it: Something went unlogged: leave everything as is.
- if your stage is “retest”:
  - if the best load you logged on “test” is unknown: Leave everything as is.
  - otherwise: Set stage to “5x3”; set working weight to the best load you logged on “test” × {resetPct}.

ret: 1 training day (A) holding 1 exercise, over block weeks train, repeating.
Block weeks: train, repeating. If you miss a session the plan waits: the next session is still the one you missed. Loads on a 2.5 kg grid.
Rotation: Each training week: Day A.
Attendance (from the rotation): Train at least 1 time in each 7-day window (from your start day). If you don't train for 21 days, attendance stops counting until your next session.

squat: 3 sets of 5 reps on Barbell Back Squat; add 2.5 kg after every session where all sets hit; after 3 misses in a row, propose dropping to 90% of the weight. Success: at least 2 sets must fully hit, capped at the sets the session issues; every logged set counts.
